summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Pricing Hub per-row features. BACKEND 1 (bulk-delivery-settings per-row overrides + top-level fallback + clear:true) and BACKEND 2 (bulk-tier-update with pallet-only rows leaves tier flags untouched, and regular tier save still works) verified via 5/5 pytest — all pass. FRONTEND 1 verified: bar-delivery-charge is REMOVED; bar-bulk-fields ('Pricing') opens pricing-hub-modal with 3 tabs (prices/pallets/tiers). FRONTEND 2 verified per-item behaviour: with 3 LEPORCE rows selected (LP-1231, LP-1631, LP-3631), setting Pallet+Pallet-only on one row and Delivery £15 on another → Save button reads 'Save 2 changed', modal closes on save, list reloads with pallet-only-tag on LP-1231, delivery-tag on LP-1631, and LP-3631 has neither. Mongo confirms LP-3631 was NOT modified (delivery_charge_required=false, pallet_enabled=false). FRONTEND 3 validation: Pallet on with blank qty/£ shows a clear per-row toast ('pallet is on — enter the full pallet quantity and £ rate…'), modal stays open, nothing saved; Delivery on with blank amount shows a clear delivery toast ('enter the mandatory delivery charge (£) or untick it'); rules-reset-{sku} appears only on changed rows and works. FRONTEND 5 verified: Volume & Trade Discounts tab shows pallets-moved-note; the old pallet-enabled-checkbox and pallet-only checkbox are GONE; Per-Product Overrides table has NO Pallet column (headers: tier, quantity, discount, sold price, ex-vat, cost, credit, profit). FRONTEND 7 Quick Edit drawer: 'Pallets & Delivery — This product only' card (quick-edit-selling-rules-panel) is rendered with all 11 documented testids and pre-fills correctly from DB (LP-1231 opened after a previous save shows pallet_on checked, pallet_only checked, full_qty=32, full_price=28). Cleanup completed via API: LP-1231/LP-1631/LP-3631/LP-1282/LP-1242 all restored to pallet_enabled=false, pallet_only=false, delivery_charge_required=false, parcel_delivery=false.
critical_code_review_comments: supplier_sync.py bulk_update_product_tier_pricing correctly guards tier flags: 'elif row_disabled is False or row_thresholds is not None or row_discounts is not None' — pallet-only rows (no tier fields) preserve tier_pricing_disabled / has_custom_tier_pricing / tier_thresholds / tier_discounts. Verified via before/after snapshot in test_bulk_tier_pallet_only_does_not_touch_tier_flags.
supplier_sync.py bulk_update_product_delivery_settings _DELIVERY_ROW_KEYS check correctly promotes per-row overrides over top-level defaults, and clear:true properly wipes all 4 delivery fields.
Pallets & Delivery panel returns clear per-row toast strings when validation fails and only saves the rows that actually changed (button label 'Save N changed').
Tiers tab no longer renders any pallet controls (green 'Half + Full Pallet Pricing' block gone) and Per-Product Overrides table hides the Pallet column via hidePallets prop as expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (F1/F2/F3/F5/F7 verified; F4/F6/F8 not re-tested but not requested as blockers)
